```{r}
case_env <- new.env()
case_env$gw <- read.csv("../evaluation_data_GreenWaste_simple.csv")
sys.source("../greenwaste_case.R", envir = case_env)
city <- case_env$city
took <- city$took_part == 1
reading <- list(
  before = mean(city$cost_before[took]),
  after = mean(city$cost_after[took]),
  change = case_env$case$before_after,
  other_change = mean(city$change[!took]),
  starting_gap = abs(case_env$case$gap_before),
  rule = case_env$RULE,
  saving = abs(case_env$case$rct),
  interval = sort(abs(case_env$case$rct_ci))
)
fmt <- function(x) formatC(x, digits = 0, format = "f", big.mark = ",")
```

```{=html}
<style>
:root { --blue:#215a9e; --navy:#063360; --pale:#eef4fa; --light:#7da1c4; --ink:#17212b; --muted:#545860; --line:#c9d7e5; --alert:#a22127; }
* { box-sizing:border-box; }
body { margin:0; background:#fff; color:var(--ink); font-family:"Noto Kufi Arabic","Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif; font-size:18px; line-height:1.55; }

button:focus-visible,textarea:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--blue); outline-offset:3px; }

.primary { background:var(--blue); border-color:var(--blue); color:white; }
.primary:hover { background:var(--navy); }

.reveal { border-top:1px solid var(--line); padding-top:25px; margin-top:30px; }
.result-chart { width:100%; display:block; }
.claim-list { list-style:none; padding:0; margin:20px 0; counter-reset:claim; }

.claim-list button { width:100%; text-align:left; border:0; border-radius:0; padding:19px 15px; }
.claim-list button::before { counter-increment:claim; content:counter(claim) ". "; font-weight:650; }
.claim-list button[aria-pressed="true"] { background:var(--pale); color:var(--navy); box-shadow:inset 4px 0 var(--blue); }
.feedback { min-height:45px; margin:20px 0; }
textarea { display:block; width:100%; min-height:110px; font:inherit; padding:13px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:5px; margin:12px 0; resize:vertical; }

.write-space { min-height:70px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); margin:8px 0 20px; }

.paper-table th:first-child,.paper-table td:first-child { text-align:left; }

[hidden] { display:none!important; }
@media(max-width:600px) { main { padding:0!important; } #reading-preview { padding:20px 18px 40px; } body { font-size:17px; } .brand { align-items:flex-start; } .brand img { width:160px; } .meta { max-width:135px; } .worksheet { padding:22px; } .choices button { flex:1 1 150px; } .lead { font-size:21px; } }
@media print {

 .worksheet p { margin-bottom:10px; }
 .paper-table { font-size:12pt; }
 .paper-table th,.paper-table td { padding:8px; }
 .write-space { min-height:16mm; }
 .task-num { font-size:12pt; }
 .notice { font-size:9pt; }
}

<section id="evidence-panel" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="evidence-tab">

 </div>

 <button type="button" class="primary" id="open-evidence" disabled>Open the evidence</button>
 <div id="evidence-reveal" class="reveal" hidden>
  <h2>A fall is an observed change</h2>

  </div>
  <p>The groups were already different before GreenWaste. Neither a fall over time nor a gap between these groups proves what the programme caused.</p>
  <p class="prompt">What would make the comparison fair?</p>

  <div id="pilot-reveal" class="reveal" hidden>

   <p id="interval-text"></p>

  </div>
```

```{r results='asis'}
cat('<script id="reading-data" type="application/json">',
    jsonlite::toJSON(reading, auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 6), '</script>')
```

```{=html}
<script>
(() => {
 const root = document.getElementById('reading-preview');
 const data = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('reading-data').textContent);
 const el = id => document.getElementById(id);
 const format = value => Math.round(value).toLocaleString('en-GB');
 const tabs = [...root.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]')];
 function selectTab(tab) {
  tabs.forEach(t => {
   const active = t === tab;
   t.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(active));
   el(t.getAttribute('aria-controls')).hidden = !active;
  });
  if(tab.id === 'evidence-tab') drawInterval();
 }
 tabs.forEach((tab,index) => {
  tab.addEventListener('click',() => selectTab(tab));
  tab.addEventListener('keydown',event => {
   if(!['ArrowRight','ArrowLeft','Home','End'].includes(event.key)) return;
   event.preventDefault();
   const next = event.key === 'Home' ? 0 : event.key === 'End' ? tabs.length - 1 : (index + (event.key === 'ArrowRight' ? 1 : -1) + tabs.length) % tabs.length;
   selectTab(tabs[next]); tabs[next].focus();
  });
 });
 el('cost-fall').textContent = format(Math.abs(data.change));
 el('other-rise').textContent = format(data.other_change);
 const choices = [...el('opening-choices').querySelectorAll('button')];
 choices.forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click',() => {
  choices.forEach(b => b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(b===button)));
  el('choice-status').textContent = `Your initial choice: ${button.textContent}. Give a reason before opening the evidence.`;
  el('open-evidence').disabled = false;
 }));
 el('open-evidence').addEventListener('click',() => {
  el('evidence-reveal').hidden = false;
  el('open-evidence').hidden = true;
 });
 el('open-pilot').addEventListener('click',() => {
  el('pilot-reveal').hidden = false;
  el('open-pilot').hidden = true;
  drawInterval();
 });
 el('show-reading').addEventListener('click',() => {
  el('careful-reading').hidden = !el('careful-reading').hidden;
  el('show-reading').textContent = el('careful-reading').hidden ? 'Compare with a careful reading' : 'Hide the reading';
 });
 el('interval-text').textContent = `Estimated saving: ${format(data.saving)} AED per business per year. Reported 95% confidence interval: ${format(data.interval[0])} to ${format(data.interval[1])} AED. Decision rule: ${format(data.rule)} AED.`;
 function drawInterval() {
  const svg = el('interval-chart');
  if(el('pilot-reveal').hidden || el('evidence-panel').hidden) return;
  const width = Math.max(250,Math.round(svg.getBoundingClientRect().width));
  const height = width < 450 ? 210 : 195;
  const left = 20, right = width - 35;
  const max = Math.ceil(Math.max(data.rule,data.interval[1]) * 1.2 / 200) * 200;
  const x = value => left + value / max * (right-left);
  const tickValues = width < 450 ? [0,max/2,max] : [0,max/4,max/2,3*max/4,max];
  const ticks = tickValues.map(value => `<line x1="${x(value)}" x2="${x(value)}" y1="116" y2="122" stroke="#545860"/><text x="${x(value)}" y="143" text-anchor="${value===0?'start':value===max?'end':'middle'}" font-size="14" fill="#17212b">${format(value)}</text>`).join('');
  svg.setAttribute('viewBox',`0 0 ${width} ${height}`);
  svg.innerHTML = `<title>Pilot trial saving and uncertainty</title><desc>The estimate is ${format(data.saving)} AED. The confidence interval, ${format(data.interval[0])} to ${format(data.interval[1])} AED, crosses the ${format(data.rule)} AED decision rule.</desc>
   <line x1="${left}" x2="${right}" y1="116" y2="116" stroke="#c9d7e5"/>
   <line x1="${x(data.rule)}" x2="${x(data.rule)}" y1="40" y2="116" stroke="#a22127" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/>
   <text x="${x(data.rule)}" y="25" text-anchor="end" font-size="15" fill="#a22127">Rule: ${format(data.rule)}</text>
   <line x1="${x(data.interval[0])}" x2="${x(data.interval[1])}" y1="73" y2="73" stroke="#215a9e" stroke-width="5"/>
   <line x1="${x(data.interval[0])}" x2="${x(data.interval[0])}" y1="63" y2="83" stroke="#215a9e" stroke-width="3"/>
   <line x1="${x(data.interval[1])}" x2="${x(data.interval[1])}" y1="63" y2="83" stroke="#215a9e" stroke-width="3"/>
   <circle cx="${x(data.saving)}" cy="73" r="7" fill="#063360"/>
   ${ticks}<text x="${left}" y="180" font-size="15" fill="#17212b">Annual saving per business (AED)</text>`;
 }
 const selected = new Set();
 const claimButtons = [...el('claim-list').querySelectorAll('button')];
 el('summary-evidence').textContent = `Average annual waste costs for the city businesses that took part: ${format(data.before)} AED before GreenWaste; ${format(data.after)} AED 12 months later.`;
 el('claim-0').textContent = `Average costs were ${format(Math.abs(data.change))} AED lower after joining.`;
 claimButtons.forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click',() => {
  const id = Number(button.dataset.claim);
  if(selected.has(id)) selected.delete(id); else selected.add(id);
  button.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(selected.has(id)));
  el('claim-feedback').textContent = '';
  el('claim-explanation').hidden = true;
 }));
 el('check-claims').addEventListener('click',() => {
  const right = selected.size === 3 && [1,2,3].every(id=>selected.has(id));
  el('claim-feedback').textContent = right ? 'Your reading matches the evidence: sentences 2, 3 and 4 overclaim.' : 'Compare each sentence with the extract. It reports an average change; it does not establish cause, individual savings or a national decision.';
  el('claim-explanation').hidden = false;
 });
 el('paper-rule').textContent = format(data.rule);
 el('paper-before').textContent = format(data.before);
 el('paper-after').textContent = format(data.after);
 el('print-sheet').addEventListener('click',()=>window.print());
 if(window.ResizeObserver) new ResizeObserver(drawInterval).observe(el('interval-chart'));
 window.addEventListener('resize',drawInterval);
})();
</script>
```
